Twenty subjects were enrolled in this study, they were either males (eight) or females (12), with a mean age of 47.8 ± 4.45 years and each patient was treated with one implant. Simultaneous contour augmentation with guided bone regeneration was performed u sing synthetic bone particles (maxresorb®) and an ADM (mucoderm®). Keratinized mucosa width (KMW) and gingival thickness (GT) were assessed at baseline, 1, 3, 6, 12 and 24 months.
